subject: [Rqtl-disc] F2 and BC segregating markers to make a linkage map

messages.author: c40b24db88b3a3fc
messages.subject: [Rqtl-disc] F2 and BC segregating markers to make a linkage map
parts:
hi all!
I am trying to design the linkage map for my organisms since I do not
have one. I have F2 cross but since it was not done from the inbreed
line, there are some markers that are segregating in the normal F2
fashion and the others that are segregating in Back cross fashion,
because the F1 were not heterozygous for all the markers that were
typed but rather homozygous for one of the F1 for some markers. The
same individuals are typed for all this markers
So treat each group of the markers separately and do all this steps of
estimating rf and do the linkage groups and than join them, or on
which point I can join this data to perform the best map by
integrating this two group of markers into one map?
Thank you!

--

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] F2 and BC segregating markers to make a linkage map
parts:
I don't have much experience with this, but here are my initial thoughts:

If you have quite a lot of fully informative markers, you should be able to do everything all at once.

If there are just a few fully informative markers, you should probably work with the two groups of backcross-type markers separately, but including all fully informative ones in each, and then look to see whether you can merge the two maps afterwards. You'd need at least two fully informative markers on a linkage group, and it'd be best if you had more, in order to merge the two groups of markers into one map.

karl
-----------
Karl Broman
kbr...@biostat.wisc.edu
http://www.biostat.wisc.edu/~kbroman

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: F2 and BC segregating markers to make a linkage  map
parts:
You need the F2-type markers to tie the two groups of BC-type markers together. I would use all of those with each of your two sets of BC-type markers, in initially forming the linkage map.

karl
